title: Placement
description: auto: the top strip between HP bar and score (osu!, catch), under the lane (taiko), beside the stage under score and accuracy (mania). top: the top strip. under: below the playfield/lane (catch falls back to top, the catcher lives there). side: right of the playfield/stage (taiko falls back to under).

title: Alignment
description: Where the line sits inside its band; auto centres it in the top and osu! under bands, keeps it left under the taiko lane and right beside the stage.

title: Nudge X / px
description: Moves the line horizontally, for skins that place the HUD elsewhere.

title: Scale
description: Size multiplier, 0.5–2. The line still keeps to its band's width.

title: Backing
description: none floats the text on the game; scrim adds a soft dark wash that fades out at its edges; panel draws the 18-LAB graphite panel.

title: Accent
description: map tints the star, progress line and tag from the beatmap's background colours; 18-lab keeps the amber accent.

title: Original-language metadata
description: Show artist and title in their original script when the map provides it; otherwise the romanised fields are used.

title: Star rating
description: Star rating with the active mods applied.

title: Mods
description: Mods of the current play. Hidden when no mods are active.

title: Long lines
description: marquee scrolls a line that does not fit its band, pausing at both ends; truncate ends it with an ellipsis. Lines that fit never move.

title: Maximum width / px
description: Widest the line may grow; it is also limited to its band. Clamped to 240–1872 px.

title: Mania column width
description: Your skin's ColumnWidth (osu!stable default 30). Used to keep the line clear of the mania stage.

title: Mania column start
description: Your skin's ColumnStart (osu!stable default 136): where the stage's left edge sits.
